card.text: EPIC 211945201 b was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.

sources.quote: It is also called EPIC 211945201 b.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around EPIC 211945201. Its orbit and size follow Livingston et al. 2018's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Livingston et al. 2018
sources.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname LIVINGSTON_ET_AL__2018): disc_year 2018, disc_facility K2, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 19.4921473, pl_radj 0.51387278, pl_bmassj 0.03460987

sources.label: Wikipedia, "K2-236b"
sources.quote: Its mass is 27 Earths, it takes 19.5 days to complete one orbit of its star, and is 0.148 AU from its star.

shape.summary: A sphere at the published size. No picture of its surface exists.
